newsitem.title: MEXICO: Mexico Cetes rate ease on U.S. long bond.
newsitem.headline: Mexico Cetes rate ease on U.S. long bond.

text.p: Mexican overnight Cetes rates closed down 25 basis points to 21.75 percent on Tuesday, after month-end pressures eased, U.S. long bond yields fell and the peso gained strength, traders said.

"It seems that we woke up in another country today. The market was very speculative yesterday and very calm today," a trader said, adding that much pressure in recent sessions was due to demand for liquidity to close books for the month, quarter and first half of the year.
The U.S. 30-year Treasury bond was up 18/32 in late trade to yield 6.74 percent.
